text:
Nadia (CS): Quick thread to craft a tiny customer-facing 'kickstart' note: lazy-fetch vs prefill, one pasteable config, a short trouble command, and a 3-pt feedback ping. need something compact for kickoff emails.
Omar (Solutions): Good. label it "Kickstart Defaults" and call out where to tighten settings for sensitive data.
Bea (Eng): Recommend different wording: lazy-fetch (on-demand) vs warm-prefill (proactive). include small warm pool note for sudden surges.
Nadia (CS): Draft bullets: - warm-prefill: use when you have a stable set of high-value prompts; default safety TTL = 3600s, warm-pool size = 5-10 concurrent entries. - lazy-fetch: best for varied prompts; use client debounce (120ms) + server batch window 40ms. - streaming: enable for typing UX or outputs >250 tokens; disable for quick classification hits.
Ravi (PM): Add renewal/health signals: 1) weekly active sessions down >30% vs baseline -> CS check-in. 2) sustained error rate >1% for 24h -> SE/Eng page. 3) no feedback ping response at day 7 -> schedule call.
Omar (Solutions): Pasteable YAML (one-liner style customers like):
```yaml
kickstart_defaults:
  warm_prefill: {enabled: true, ttl_s: 3600, warm_pool: 8}
  lazy_fetch: {debounce_ms: 120, server_batch_ms: 40}
  streaming: {threshold_tokens: 250}
```
Bea (Eng): Dev notes (2 lines): - KV cache keys: tenant|schema|prompt-sha256. - Batch window tradeoff: 20-60ms = lowest latency; 60-200ms = best cost per token.
Nadia (CS): Feedback ping (day 7) copy: "2 quick Qs: 1) Is relevance OK? (1-5) 2) Any latency surprises? (yes/no). Reply here or use <short link>." keep it one line.
Omar (Solutions): Add a one-sentence cost note: "Hosted customers: longer TTL increases request reduction but may raise storage/refresh cost; expect ~5-15% token savings per warm-prefill depending on reuse."
Bea (Eng): Troubleshooting snippet (redwoodctl check):
```
redwoodctl metrics get --tenant $TENANT --window 5m --fields throughput,p95,errors
```
Nadia (CS): Nice. Can we also include a short rollback tip if prefill causes stale outputs?
Bea (Eng): Yes: "If stale outputs observed, rotate schema version in KV key (ver++), flush warm-pool for tenant, and re-prefill with latest corpus." two-liner.
